## Checklist
- [ ] PR title follows Conventional Commits, e.g. `feat(ui): show a setting`
- [ ] Commits are signed off (`git commit -s`)
- [ ] Tests added/updated; coverage not lowered
- [ ] No new network calls (or documented, user-initiated, and allow-listed)
- [ ] No hard-coded colors (tokens only)
- [ ] README/docs updated if user-visible
